title: Size Matters Not
text:
If you control a Force unit, this upgrade costs 1 resource less to play.
Attached unit's printed power is considered to be 5 and its printed HP is considered to be 5.
rules:
"Printed power" and "printed HP" refer to the numbers physically printed on the card. While Size Matters Not is attached to a unit, those numbers are both considered to be 5. These numbers can then be modified by other abilities and upgrades attached to that unit.
If multiple abilities or effects change the printed power or printed HP of a card, the most recent ability or effect to become active determines the card's printed values.
